# cmdk-engine

> Permission-aware command palette engine for React. Works with cmdk or Base UI.

cmdk-engine is a headless command palette engine that adds the following to cmdk or Base UI:
- Route discovery: a runtime scanner for React Router routes, and a CLI that scans React Router and Next.js route files
- RBAC/permission-based command filtering
- Frecency ranking (frequency + recency based ordering)
- Keyword synonyms and user aliases. A query equal to a synonym key or value also returns what the other terms match, after the direct matches; partial words do not expand
- Async command sources (e.g. server-side search) loaded per query with debounce, abort and per-source errors. A source's `trigger` runs during render (twice under StrictMode), so it must be pure and cheap; one that passes on an empty query loads at mount, even before the palette is opened
- Search that matches the words of a query in any order and ignores accents, with the built-in fuzzy search or match-sorter
- Palette events for analytics (`useCommandPaletteEvents`), and `onSelectError` for failing actions
- CLI tool for route scanning in CI/CD pipelines

## Installation

```bash
npm install cmdk-engine cmdk
# or: bun add cmdk-engine cmdk
# Base UI instead of cmdk: npm install cmdk-engine @base-ui/react
```

Peers, all optional (install what you use): react and react-dom 18 or 19, cmdk ^1, @base-ui/react ^1.1, match-sorter 7 or 8, react-router 6, 7 or 8. Node.js 20 or later is needed by the CLI only.

## Entry Points

- `cmdk-engine` — Core engine (types, registry, search, access control, frecency)
- `cmdk-engine/react` — React hooks (Provider, useCommandPalette, useCommandRegister)
- `cmdk-engine/adapters/cmdk` — cmdk UI integration
- `cmdk-engine/adapters/react-router` — React Router route auto-discovery
- `cmdk-engine/search/match-sorter` — Optional match-sorter search backend
- `cmdk-engine/adapters/base-ui` — Base UI integration (Autocomplete + Dialog), with the cmdk adapter's props except vimBindings; optional peer `@base-ui/react` ^1.1.0
- `cmdk-engine/adapters/sitemap`: `sitemapToCommands(sitemap, { params })` turns the `command-routes.json` written by `cmdk-engine scan` into commands

## CLI

```bash
npx cmdk-engine init      # Create config file
npx cmdk-engine scan      # Scan routes, generate sitemap
npx cmdk-engine scan --include-dynamic locale   # Keep routes under a [locale] folder
npx cmdk-engine validate  # Validate config
```

## Docs

- [Getting Started](https://priyans-hu.github.io/cmdk-engine/docs/getting-started/): install, register commands, add the palette and the shortcut
- [Styling](https://priyans-hu.github.io/cmdk-engine/docs/styling/): starter CSS, Tailwind, class name props and data attributes
- [Search](https://priyans-hu.github.io/cmdk-engine/docs/search/): scoring, synonyms, match-sorter and custom engines
- [Nested commands and groups](https://priyans-hu.github.io/cmdk-engine/docs/nested-commands/): sub-menus, breadcrumbs, group headings
- [CLI](https://priyans-hu.github.io/cmdk-engine/docs/cli/): scan routes into a sitemap, config file, CI recipes
- [API Reference](https://priyans-hu.github.io/cmdk-engine/docs/api/): provider options, the command object, hooks, translations, types
- [Core API](https://priyans-hu.github.io/cmdk-engine/docs/core/): registry, frecency, groups and the other framework-agnostic parts
- [Adapters](https://priyans-hu.github.io/cmdk-engine/docs/adapters/): CommandPalette props for cmdk and Base UI, scanRoutes for React Router
- [Examples](https://priyans-hu.github.io/cmdk-engine/docs/examples/): React Router, RBAC, a custom UI, hooks and a test
- [The README as plain text](https://priyans-hu.github.io/cmdk-engine/llms-full.txt)
